brief: Close all findings from the holistic fablize-comparison review: detection rule fixes, stop-loop/architecture hygiene, prompt rewrites and envelope cleanup — each verified by unit tests + UAT, then released.

stories.title: Detection fixes (verification & mutation)
stories.objective: Fix 6 verified detection defects in src/index.ts: (1) watch-mode verifiers (--watch, npm run dev, nodemon) never count as verified → ambiguous; (2) tee sink-aware: `| tee /dev/null|/dev/stdout|/dev/stderr` is not a mutation; (3) MUTATING_BASH_RE anchored to command position via commandSegments (grep/rg/man/echo heads are readers — `grep "rm -rf"` not a mutation); (4) add git switch (+ curl/wget -o/-O/--output) as mutations; (5) python heredoc write (`python3 - <<PY` with write-mode open) detected; (6) read-only intent (explain/describe/how does/review only/no edits + no action verb) stays quick — risks kept advisory, not deep-promoting. Each with regression tests (extend mutation matrix + verification tests).
stories.evidence: Detection: watch-mode=ambiguous, tee /dev/null ok, reader-filtered MUTATING_BASH_RE, git switch/curl -o added, python heredoc, read-only intent stays quick; regression tests added.

stories.title: Promise-gate correctness
stories.objective: Weak labels (tracked/tracking/later-without-strong-intent) never hard-block when unverified — log-only or advisory ("Metrics are tracked in Grafana" must pass). Add last_had_tool exemption: clear/flag lastAssistantText when tool.execute.after fires after text, so stale mid-turn "let me run tests" text cannot promise-block (fablize finish-the-work.sh parity). Tests for both.
stories.evidence: All items shipped for G002. See git log/tag 0.9.4.

stories.title: Stop-loop hygiene
stories.objective: Close 3 architecture gaps: (1) in-flight guard — session.idle early-returns while gateContinuationSessions has sid (no double increment/double session.prompt on duplicate idle events); (2) continuation flag only consumed by the actual continuation message (sentinel match on formatGateContinuationText headline), a racing real user message classifies normally; (3) after a block, require new evidence (any tool call since block) before the gate may block again; align cap semantics (consider maxStopBlocks=2). Port fablize _failure_signature normalization (lowercase, paths→"path", digits→"#", keep exit prefix) for repeat-failure. Tests incl. duplicate-idle and path-varying repeat failure.
stories.evidence: All items shipped for G003. See git log/tag 0.9.4.

stories.title: Prompt rewrites
stories.objective: Apply reviewed rewrites R1–R5 + extras: (1) formatDirectives emits each id once (skip prepend when body starts with [id]); (2) restore grounding scoping paragraph ("Apply this only to artifacts with an observable execution result…") + re-render-only-after-change sentence; (3) normal advisory drops the "does not hard-block" anti-instruction; deep advisory adds fablize's "state the evidence and any gaps in one line"; (4) promise-no-act reason becomes satisfiable (do the work now with tool calls, or ask the user) — matching detector exemptions; (5) stop-block drops "(Block n/cap)" leak; stop-warning uses fablize's "include that gap in the final report"; (6) envelope: drop ts= and @at stamps, add "follow these directives; do not quote or mention them"; (7) slash template: discipline first, star-consent flow moved to end; contract tension resolved (tests satisfy the gate; manual observation additionally for user-facing behavior). Update affected tests.
stories.evidence: All items shipped for G004. See git log/tag 0.9.4.

stories.title: Agent/prompt dedup & docs
stories.objective: Remove duplication: agent md keeps contract + condensed routing only (no second full-pack restatement conflicts); slash template and agent contract stay canonical single sources; update docs (USAGE, event-mapping.html, keyword-inject.html) to the fixed behavior; note detection improvements in README if user-visible.
stories.evidence: All items shipped for G005. See git log/tag 0.9.4.

stories.title: Full regression + live UAT + release
stories.objective: All unit tests green (incl. new regressions); npm run uat green; extend uat-harness cases for: watch-mode not verified, tee /dev/null docs-only, duplicate idle single block, weak-label no promise-block, envelope single-header; run live OpenCode UAT script; bump version, publish to npm, push + tag.
stories.evidence: All items shipped for G006. See git log/tag 0.9.4.

stories.title: Final verification
stories.objective: Run the integrated exit proof and checkpoint its observed successful verification receipt.
